A '''Cathar female''' [[Parent/Legends|mothered]] a girl, naming her [[Juhani]]. Around [[3963 BBY]], after the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] [[Taris Siege|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], After [[Juhani's father]] was slain by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Xor]], the mother worked herself to death trying to support Juhani.
